design_philosophy: Calm, clean, and premium iOS-first experience. Focuses on minimal cognitive load, soft organic tones, and high-end typography to reflect an advanced, personalized cognitive AI.

buttons.primary: bg-[#3A453A] text-white rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-transform hover:scale-[1.02] active:scale-[0.98]
buttons.secondary: bg-[#F2F2F0] text-[#1C1C1A] rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-transform hover:bg-[#EBEBE8] active:scale-[0.98]
buttons.ghost: text-[#6B6B66] rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-medium hover:text-[#1C1C1A] hover:bg-[#F2F2F0]/50

inputs.text: w-full bg-[#FFFFFF] border border-[#EBEBE8] rounded-2xl px-4 py-3 text-[#1C1C1A] placeholder:text-[#6B6B66] focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#3A453A]/20 transition-all
inputs.chat_input: w-full bg-[#FFFFFF] border border-[#EBEBE8] rounded-full px-5 py-3 pr-12 text-[#1C1C1A] shadow-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#3A453A]/20

cards.default: bg-[#FFFFFF] border border-[#EBEBE8] rounded-[32px] p-6 shadow-sm
cards.premium_paywall: bg-gradient-to-b from-[#FFFFFF] to-[#FBFBF9] border border-[#D17D5C]/30 rounded-[32px] p-8 shadow-md relative overflow-hidden

headers.sticky_glass: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#EBEBE8] px-6 py-4 flex items-center justify-between

microinteractions.hover_state: Slight lift (-translate-y-0.5) and shadow increase for cards; background darken for buttons.
microinteractions.page_transition: Fade in and slight slide up (opacity 0 to 1, translate-y-4 to 0).
microinteractions.chat_bubble_enter: Pop in from bottom with spring physics (scale 0.95 to 1, opacity 0 to 1).

icons_and_assets.images_strategy: Minimal image usage. Prefer typography, layout, and white space. Use abstract soft shapes for onboarding if needed.

screens.onboarding: Distraction-free, single question per screen with large elegant typography. Progress indicated by a subtle top bar.
screens.chat_main: Clean iOS-like chat interface. Sticky glass header with AI model selector. Bottom input area with voice recording button prominently featured. Messages should have generous padding.
screens.paywall: Triggered on voice button click or message limit. Elegant modal sliding from bottom. Focus on value of 'Voice' and 'Infinite Memory'. Use the accent color (#D17D5C) subtly for premium cues.
screens.profile_memory: List view of extracted user facts. Cards representing memory chunks. Clean, organized like Apple Settings.
screens.admin_panel: Swiss high-contrast data table approach for clarity. Sidebar navigation, dense data tables for users and subscriptions.

testing.rules: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, chat bubbles, plan selectors) MUST include `data-testid` using kebab-case role-based naming (e.g., `data-testid="chat-send-button"`).

tech_stack_guidelines.frontend: React with .js files (as specified in rules), Tailwind CSS. Avoid complex class manipulations, use template literals or clsx/tailwind-merge.
tech_stack_guidelines.state: Ensure optimistic UI updates for chat interactions to maintain a fast iOS-native feel.
